name: CRITICAL WARNING: Sushi Bar Baked Dynamite Roll (Heavy Kewpie Mayo Grease Bomb)
whyItWorks: A California roll buried under chopped scallops, shrimp, and an immense blanket of Japanese Kewpie mayonnaise mixed with sugar and sriracha, baked under a salamander until bubbling grease. A massive 60g+ fat bomb that triggers violent diarrhea.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Strictly avoid baked mayo sushi rolls. Stick to clean, unbaked nigiri or plain sashimi.
